entities.summary: Vasili Pavlovich Ponomaryov is a Russian professional ice hockey player for Avangard Omsk in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Carolina Hurricanes and the Pittsburgh Penguins.
